content.text: I’m going to make a scoped mechanical pass over `253/**/*.md`: convert `lim_(variable → target)` into `\lim_{variable \to target}` and normalize only the symbols inside that limit subscript, like `∞`, `π`, and `θ`. That keeps the change focused on the broken construct.

content.title:
ruby -e '
Dir.glob("253/**/*.md").each do |file|
  text = File.read(file)
  out = +""
  i = 0
  changed = false
  while i < text.length
    if text.start_with?("lim_(", i)
      j = i + 5
      depth = 1
      while j < text.length && depth > 0
        ch = text[j]
        if ch == "("
          depth += 1
        elsif ch == ")"
          depth -= 1
          break if depth == 0
        end
        j += 1
      end

      if depth == 0
        inner = text[(i + 5)...j]
        inner = inner.gsub("→", "\\to")
                     .gsub("∞", "\\infty")
                     .gsub("π", "\\pi")
                     .gsub("θ", "\\theta")
        inner = inner.gsub(/\s*\\to\s*/, " \\to ")
                     .gsub(/-\s*\\infty/, "-\\infty")
                     .gsub(/\+\s*\\infty/, "+\\infty")
        out << "\\lim_{#{inner}}"
        i = j + 1
        changed = true
      else
        out << text[i]
        i += 1
      end
    else
      out << text[i]
      i += 1
    end
  end
  File.write(file, out) if changed
end
'
